citations.quote: The trading industry has a buy side and a sell side. The buy side consists of traders who buy exchange services.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The trading industry splits into a buy side that purchases exchange services (chiefly liquidity) and a sell side of dealers and brokers that supplies them; brokers act as agents and owe an agency duty of best execution.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: The Trading Industry: Who Trades, Brokers, and the Buy Side
